patterns.name: Base-anchored variety
patterns.description: Return to base 0 every stroke while reach gradually varies between short and broad. Pace stays independent.

patterns.name: Base-anchored drift
patterns.description: Return to base 0 while reach wanders gradually and irregularly. Longer variation memory; pace stays independent.

patterns.name: Breathing window
patterns.description: Gradually move a varying-width window through the band. Width wanders between 20 and 65; neither endpoint stays anchored.

patterns.name: Centered drift
patterns.description: Keep the middle fixed while stroke width wanders gradually and irregularly. Both endpoints move symmetrically.

patterns.name: Centered variety
patterns.description: Gradually vary stroke width symmetrically around the middle. Both endpoints move; neither endpoint is anchored.

patterns.name: Even-beat variety
patterns.description: Vary width irregularly around the middle while holding a steadier cycle beat. Short strokes travel more slowly.

patterns.name: Full sweeps
patterns.description: Repeat smooth full-length strokes from base 0 to tip 100. Fixed reach and even pace.

patterns.name: Lower strokes
patterns.description: Repeat smooth fixed-width strokes only in the lower/base region, 0–40. Even pace.

patterns.name: Middle strokes
patterns.description: Repeat smooth fixed-width strokes only around the middle, 30–70. Even pace.

patterns.name: Pace wave
patterns.description: Keep every stroke full-length while pace gradually slows and rises over eight cycles. Reach does not change.

patterns.name: Soft turnarounds
patterns.description: Keep full-length strokes and even pace with longer, gentler turnarounds at both ends. Reach does not vary.

patterns.name: Tip-anchored variety
patterns.description: Return to tip 100 every stroke while reach gradually varies between short and broad. Pace stays independent.

patterns.name: Tip-anchored drift
patterns.description: Return to tip 100 while reach wanders gradually and irregularly. Longer variation memory; pace stays independent.

patterns.name: Traveling window
patterns.description: Keep a 40-wide stroke window and gradually move it from lower to middle to upper and back. Preserve stroke width.

patterns.name: Upper strokes
patterns.description: Repeat smooth fixed-width strokes only in the upper/tip region, 60–100. Even pace.

patterns.name: Wide then narrow
patterns.description: Repeat four full-width cycles, then four middle-width cycles. Blend between the two sections; keep the pace setting.

patterns.name: Three-zone tour
patterns.description: Repeat four lower cycles, four middle, four upper, then four middle. Blend each transition; retain short strokes.

patterns.name: Notched Full Sweep
patterns.description: Mostly full-span reversals with one shortened peak. Reversal timing varies within the loop.

patterns.name: Full Sweep Run A
patterns.description: Repeating full-span reversals. Reversal timing is even.

patterns.name: Full Sweep Run B

patterns.name: Full Sweep Run C

patterns.name: Peak Steps

patterns.name: Upper Cascade
patterns.description: An upper-biased sequence moves through several return depths and peaks. Grouped timing creates offbeat accents.

patterns.name: Return Depth Shuffle
patterns.description: Broad strokes shuffle among full and partial return depths. Reversal timing varies within the loop.

patterns.name: Broken Full Sweep
patterns.description: Full-span reversals are interrupted by a small set of partial returns. Reversal timing is even.

patterns.name: Peak Ladder Mosaic

patterns.name: Midrange Break

patterns.name: Descending Peak Finish

patterns.name: Multi-Level Circuit A

patterns.name: Return Ladder
